session_summary: Initial session focused on establishing a safe, practical framework for addressing transport anxiety. The mentor and student identified the main barrier as uncertainty regarding an approved alternative route and anxiety about a specific crossing. A between-session task was agreed upon (recording journey times), but no external support (e.g., formal transport assessment or route verification) has been delivered yet.

tracked_details.detail: Main barrier: Uncertainty about whether an approved alternative route exists; anxiety regarding a specific crossing point.
Intended intervention: Transport Assessment to identify safer routes or entitlements.
Delivered activity: Mapping the usual route and identifying difficult points (connection) during the session.
Agreed between-session task: Record two actual journey times before the next meeting.
Student preference: School-based next steps rather than home-based solutions; avoiding sharing private family details in records.

next_steps: Verify status of transport entitlement or alternative route approval.
Student to attempt recording journey times as agreed.
Review recorded data and adjust plan (school-based step) in next session.
uncertainties: Whether an approved alternative route exists.
conclusion: The initial session successfully established a collaborative, non-judgmental approach. While the mentor and student mapped the current route difficulties during the meeting (delivered activity), the primary intended intervention (formal Transport Assessment/Route Verification) remains pending with no evidence of receipt. The main barrier (uncertainty about the route) persists. The agreed between-session task (recording journey times) is pending. Evidence does not support improvement in the main barrier or attendance yet, as this is the first session.
